profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I've had the pleasure of working at two Software Engineering Internships where I experienced developing applications that incorporate natural language processing and speech recognition. It ignited my strong passion for learning new skills and being able to use them in everyday life. Aside from working hard creating new projects, I love being able to look back and admire the result that has come from what I have built.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Build and maintain applications in C#, vb, react and python.
